question: What three major sciences are combined in nursing informatics?
explanation: Nursing informatics merges nursing practice with computer and information sciences to manage patient data effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: Why is organizing raw patient data important in nursing informatics?

options.A: It eliminates all documentation duties for staff nurses
options.B: It ensures that patients never experience medication errors
options.C: It completely replaces the need for direct physical assessment
options.D: It turns data into useful information for clinical decisions

explanation: Raw data alone is not helpful until it is organized and analyzed to guide safe, effective patient care choices. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: What is the primary focus of clinical nursing informatics?

options.A: Writing academic textbooks for nursing schools
options.B: Managing hospital financial budgets and payroll
options.C: Teaching undergraduate students in the classroom
options.D: Direct patient care delivery and bedside technology

explanation: Clinical informatics directly supports the nurses and patients at the point of care through tools like electronic records and barcode scanners. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: A nurse uses a bedside barcode scanner before giving a drug. Which type of informatics does this represent?
explanation: Bedside verification tools directly support clinical workflows and patient safety, placing them squarely in clinical nursing informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: Administrative nursing informatics is primarily used for which of the following tasks?

options.A: Administering intravenous medications directly to patients
options.B: Managing staffing schedules, budgets, and operational metrics
options.C: Designing interactive smartphone apps for general public use
options.D: Conducting laboratory experiments on cellular disease models

explanation: Nurse leaders use administrative tools to oversee hospital operations, staffing levels, and financial or quality metrics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: How does administrative informatics differ from clinical nursing informatics?

options.A: It looks at whole hospital systems and units rather than individual bedside care
options.B: It has no connection whatsoever to patient health outcomes
options.C: It is handled exclusively by computer programmers without nursing input
options.D: It only applies to outpatient community health centers in rural areas

explanation: While clinical informatics targets the individual bedside encounter, administrative informatics evaluates broad operational and institutional trends. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Which tool is commonly used in nursing education informatics to train students safely?

options.A: Hospital payroll and staff roster tracking spreadsheets
options.C: Patient simulation software and learning management systems
options.D: National public health disease outbreak registries

explanation: Educational informatics relies heavily on learning platforms and simulation tools to build student knowledge and skills. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: Why is educational informatics particularly useful when clinical placement sites are scarce?

options.A: It automates the grading of physical bedside nursing procedures
options.B: It provides virtual patient scenarios to practice clinical reasoning
options.C: It allows students to skip graduation exams and start working early
options.D: It completely replaces the need for licensed nursing faculty

explanation: Simulation and virtual tools give students valuable practice in decision-making when real clinical wards are overcrowded. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: What is the main purpose of nursing research informatics?

options.A: Managing daily staff shift rosters and nurse-to-patient ratios
options.B: Supporting data collection and analysis to discover new nursing knowledge
options.C: Ordering routine hospital supplies and medical equipment inventory
options.D: Providing health tips and reminders to patients via mobile phones

explanation: Research informatics uses technology to manage studies, analyze data, and build the evidence base for nursing practice. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: What is NOT a typical activity managed through nursing research informatics?

options.A: Managing large health datasets and clinical trial records
options.B: Storing digital archives of peer-reviewed clinical literature
options.C: Calculating monthly salary disbursements for hospital employees
options.D: Analyzing statistical outcomes of evidence-based nursing studies

explanation: Salary calculations are an administrative task, whereas research informatics focuses on scientific studies, data analysis, and literature management. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Which of the following is a primary example of consumer health informatics?

options.B: Internal staff attendance registers used by nurse managers
options.C: Patient portals and wearable fitness tracking applications
options.D: Hospital financial ledger and budgeting software programs

explanation: Consumer health informatics centers on tools that patients use directly to track and manage their personal health. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: How do consumer health informatics tools benefit patients in their daily lives?

options.A: They encourage active participation and self-monitoring of health conditions
options.B: They replace all forms of face-to-face communication with doctors
options.C: They remove the need for professional medical diagnosis entirely
options.D: They automatically prescribe and dispense prescription medications

explanation: Portals and wearables give patients direct insight into their health data, helping them stay engaged in managing chronic illnesses. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)
